[2026-11-18 09:27 CET] Source aa04942c7e233e6eb840696e64ca6094f163ecb9 closes the conditional all-depth eager endpoint Seeds/Grows induction, its full task.work corollary, and the joint Current/Seeds law for every completed ordinary-row prefix. The proof retains the original supplied fuels, exact callers and stopped endpoints, all emitted outputs, and prefixes that emit nothing. The outer and task theorems derive their induction hypotheses internally. Entry resource and source assumptions remain explicit.

Fifteen distinct private laws are new. Private runs 41266 and 24791 passed four and eleven reports. Root independently rehashed 10,049 and 10,388 input pins. Normal publication 12064 passed gates 746 / 15 / 341 / 746 / 746. All 10,468 publication input pins were independently rehashed. Audit checked 100,294 declarations. There are no new public laws, definitions or explicit helpers. The curated count is 545 inherited plus 15 new reports, or 560. The 264 resource reports and 300 historical independent checks remain inherited.

Only the existing SharedEagerReservation proof owner changes. Its entire old 2,576,264-byte block is exact at offset 137; Audit and the other 6,285 source files are exact. Fourteen original FIRSTs remain exact. The scan FIRST corrects two nonexistent growth-relation names; the old header never elaborated. Failed whole batches 59813, 59197 and 76199 retain zero credit. The rejected restored-dsimp authoring draft never reached the compiler. Explicit delta in five expand and three outer branches resolves the local irreducibility issue without changing any statement, assumption, attribute, fuel or limit. All failures and repairs are preserved.

All ten owned terminal namespaces have been removed: 270,858,280 generated regular bytes and 37,914 links. The normal cache is preserved. Protected-process visibility errors remain explicit. No Haskell source changed and no new reachable Haskell defect was established. Older FINDINGS remain intact.

The reviewed next candidate combines a genuine ordinary-root Origin producer, a public runEager endpoint wrapper and a generic cold-cache Seeds law. These three laws are uncompiled and receive zero current credit. Complete ordered worker query coverage, public source attachment, guard and historical-constraint satisfaction, ONE finite accepted completion of the SAME original root under ONE assignment, and compiled Haskell correspondence remain open. Keep every original typing, adequacy, completeness, preprocessing/LPO, order, multiplicity, lazy-demand, exact-count, weight/training, ranking and host-bound contract in scope. Current primary usage is 13 percent. Manual continuation and origin/formalize pushes remain authorized; no goal status change or completion is claimed. Checkpoint and push are pending.
